title: ClearHead Index Query Result
description: The JSON array emitted by the CLI's in-process index query family (default, unscheduled, agenda, weekly, chain) under `--format json`. Every row is one actionable item carrying a canonical id, display fields, status, priority, and source-locator fields. This schema pins the producer contract without adding an envelope or reshaping the payload. Array order is the view's SPARQL ORDER BY and is significant. Row membership is owned by each view; this schema constrains row SHAPE, not which rows appear.

canonicalId.description: Canonical action identity as a urn:uuid IRI. This is the exact spelling the CLI resolver accepts, so a row id may drive show/update/complete/cancel without transformation.

writtenTime.description: A time as the file wrote it (ontology.md, Time; Decision 52): an xsd:date, or an xsd:dateTime with seconds and an offset only if one was written.

indexRow.description: One actionable item in an index view.

status.description: Action lifecycle state, rendered as the bare ontology state local-name. This is the full action-state domain; individual views filter which states appear (index views exclude Completed and Cancelled), but the column type is the whole domain, not a per-view subset.

source_file.description: Path to the .actions file containing this action, relative to data_root: the application graph's app:file (ontology.md, rule 3), such as charters/next.actions.

source_line.description: 1-based line number of the action within source_file.

data_root.description: Absolute path to the data root of the owning workspace (the directory holding charters/, plans/ and objectives/). The graph names no root; the producer attaches it per row, so data_root/source_file is an absolute path without external context.

priority.description: RFC 5545 priority: 1 is highest, 9 is lowest. Omitted when the action has no priority. Not projected by the default view.

parent.description: Canonical id of the immediate parent action, denormalized onto the row. Absent for root actions and for views that do not project the parent edge.

parent_name.description: Display title of the parent action (rdfs:label). Present exactly when `parent` is present.

scheduled_at.description: The Action's planned start (@) as written: app:plannedStart. Projected by dated views (agenda, weekly), which compare its instant app:plannedFrom; omitted when the Action has no planned start. Never inherited.

due_date.description: The Action's own deadline (:) as written: app:due. Projected by dated views (agenda, weekly), which compare the effective deadline app:lateFrom, so an Action can appear for an inherited deadline and carry no due_date of its own.
